Without digging into the technical parts (and as a user) I expected the two to work together but there might only be a slight overlap indeed.

This feature also seems to relate to the [unmount timeout logic](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch/blob/305ed204721d219ea925e99349bcbf54bc068a48/packages/react-instantsearch-core/src/lib/useInstantSearchApi.ts#L230) we have, and this might be an opportunity to get rid of this timeout. (Which is causing issues with HMR btw.)
